description: Generate a Felix-written strategy from plain words. Returns strategy_id for backtests and deployment; returned source is for display only and must never be sent back. Uses the account's generation budget.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable retry key. Auto-generated when omitted; reuse after a timeout.

prompt.description: Strategy idea in plain words, under 4000 characters. User-supplied code is refused.

name: generate_strategy
